title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解井區、接面及互補電路連通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: CMOS 功能與隔離
stages.description: 在「CMOS 功能與隔離」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for cmos function and isolation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 互補反相器
steps.objective: 完成「互補反相器」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw a complementary inverter, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：互補反相器。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw a complementary inverter. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「互補反相器」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「互補反相器」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw a complementary inverter: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 互補反相器的原理
knowledge.text: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。
knowledge.textEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 反相器功能來自互補拉高與拉低路徑，井與本體接點則協助維持電位及抑制寄生作用。
knowledge.textEn: An inverter uses complementary pull-up and pull-down paths, while wells and body ties maintain potentials and suppress parasitics.

quiz.question: 評估「互補反相器」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw a complementary inverter?
options: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。 反相器功能來自互補拉高與拉低路徑，井與本體接點則協助維持電位及抑制寄生作用。
quiz.explanationEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. An inverter uses complementary pull-up and pull-down paths, while wells and body ties maintain potentials and suppress parasitics.

steps.title: 井區與基板

steps.instruction: 本步問題：井區與基板。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：不同極性元件需要適當的井及本體接點。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign wells and substrate. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Different polarities need appropriate wells and body contacts. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同極性元件需要適當的井及本體接點。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Different polarities need appropriate wells and body contacts. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「井區與基板」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assign wells and substrate and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「井區與基板」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assign wells and substrate: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 遮罩層次

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for map mask hierarchy, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：遮罩層次。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：不同遮罩分別定義主動區、閘、接觸與配線。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map mask hierarchy. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Separate masks define active areas, gates, contacts and wiring. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同遮罩分別定義主動區、閘、接觸與配線。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Separate masks define active areas, gates, contacts and wiring. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「遮罩層次」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「遮罩層次」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for map mask hierarchy: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for map isolation and parasitics, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：隔離與寄生。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：隔離不足可能產生原電路圖未畫出的路徑。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map isolation and parasitics. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Insufficient isolation can create paths absent from the intended schematic. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離不足可能產生原電路圖未畫出的路徑。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map isolation and parasitics and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「隔離與寄生」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for map isolation and parasitics: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：閂鎖路徑。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：寄生雙極路徑取決於井與基板電阻及接點。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace latch-up paths. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Parasitic bipolar paths depend on well and substrate resistance and contacts. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「寄生雙極路徑取決於井與基板電阻及接點。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for trace latch-up paths: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Order thermal constraints. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: High-temperature steps modify existing dopants and films. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「高溫步驟會改變已形成的摻雜及薄膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for order thermal constraints: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.
